question: Which of the following elements has the highest atomic number?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gold has the highest atomic numbe**r of the following elements
 
• **Gold: Has an atomic number of 79**
 
• Density of Gold= 19.32 g/cc.

 Copper
 
 
 
• Symbol **Cu and atomic number= 29.**
 
• **The first metal used by man.**
 
• Copper is essential to all living organisms as a trace dietary mineral.
 
 
 
 

 Silver
 
 
 
• Silver belongs to the second transition series and group 11 elements of the periodic table.
 
• Silver belongs to D-block elements.
 
• Silver is a lustrous, soft, very ductile and malleable metal.
 
• It has the highest electrical conductivity of all metals, but it is not widely used for electrical purposes as it is very expensive.
